answer: Require every agent to lock a 400-token bond for 60 epochs before it can earn, 100% slashed on proven duplication, and cap each identity at 40 paid submissions per epoch. A rotating pool of auditors, drawn fresh each epoch, samples every identity's work and publishes verdicts in a vault. One caught clone sends a ripple through its cluster: clones that bridge many accounts through one funding source share one fate, the timber of the case, funding trail and identical submissions, is published and each bond burns. 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 tokens locked 60 epochs.
